narrative_purpose: The dim full-bleed atmospheric backdrop the chapter's text floats over: a vast dark volcanic ashland plain under a smoke-dimmed sky with faint distant vent glow, evoking the chapter's fire-and-ash mood, deliberately low-contrast so overlaid text stays readable.
subject: A vast panoramic ashland plain of dark basalt and drifting grey ash stretching to a low horizon, faint threads of dull ember-red glow marking distant volcanic vents far away, slow veils of smoke layering the air. Almost everything is dark silhouette dissolving into haze; a pale dim curve of a gas giant sits low and distant on the horizon.
scene: A wide desolate volcanic vista from a high, far vantage at deep smoky twilight, immense atmospheric haze layering the distance, everything dissolving into murk - mood, not a figure to study.
camera: Ultra-wide panoramic vista from a very high distant vantage, horizon low in the frame, great depth of layered smoke haze.
light: Very dark and low-contrast; a faint scattered dull ember-red glow from distant vents, deep indigo smoke shadow everywhere else; no bright focal light.
palette: Dominant void-indigo and charcoal ash-grey, a faint scattered dull ember-red on the far horizon, dim overall.
style: Painterly atmospheric vista, soft, dark, immersive; detail dissolving into smoke haze.
detail_level: Low and soft throughout - deliberately dim and hazy so long-form text can float over it and stay legible.
composition: Low horizon; dark ash plains receding across the frame; wide empty hazy smoke sky above; nothing bright competing for attention.
consistency_notes: Same cool Pandora palette drained toward ash-grey; any gas giant matches Polyphemus. Must stay dark and low-contrast as a background layer, distinct from the crisp bright cover.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no bright focal point, no high contrast, no sharp foreground, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares
